CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[p_Report_DataImports_CheckDataImport] 
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@OnMonth DATETIME,
	@EnterpriseId INT,
	@DataImport dbo.DataReport READONLY
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- Insert statements for procedure here
	WITH D AS (
	SELECT rdi.Code,
	       --CAST(
	       --    CASE 
	       --         WHEN rdi.PerformPreviousPeriod >= rdi2.PerformInPeriod THEN 0
	       --         ELSE 1
	       --    END AS BIT
	       --)                              AS IsWrong
	       0 AS IsWrong
	FROM   @DataImport                    AS rdi
	       INNER JOIN Report_DataImports  AS rdi2
	            ON  rdi2.EnterpriseId = @EnterpriseId
	            AND DATEDIFF(MONTH, rdi2.ForMonth, DATEADD(MONTH, -1, @OnMonth)) = 0
	            AND rdi2.Code = rdi.Code
	WHERE  rdi.Code IS NOT NULL
	       AND ISNUMERIC(LEFT(rdi.Code, 1)) = 1
	       AND rdi2.IsDeleted = 0
	)
	SELECT * FROM D WHERE IsWrong = 1
END

name: p_Report_DataImports_Delete
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[p_Report_DataImports_Delete] 
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@EnterpriseId INT,
	@OnMonth DATETIME,
	@Reason NVARCHAR(1500),
	@DeleteBy VARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRANSACTION
	BEGIN TRY
		-- Insert statements for procedure here
		INSERT INTO [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.log].dbo.Report_DataImportLogs
		  (
		    ReportId,
		    EnterpriseId,
		    ForMonth,
		    TypeReport,
		    TypeReportName,
		    Targets,
		    Unit,
		    Code,
		    PerformPreviousPeriod,
		    PerformInPeriod,
		    AccumulatedBeginingOfYear,
		    ComparedSamePeriodLastYear,
		    IsDeleted,
		    ActionType,
		    Reason,
		    CreatedBy,
		    CreatedDate
		  )
		SELECT rdi.ReportId,
		       rdi.EnterpriseId,
		       rdi.ForMonth,
		       rdi.TypeReport,
		       rdi.TypeReportName,
		       rdi.Targets,
		       rdi.Unit,
		       rdi.Code,
		       rdi.PerformPreviousPeriod,
		       rdi.PerformInPeriod,
		       rdi.AccumulatedBeginingOfYear,
		       rdi.ComparedSamePeriodLastYear,
		       rdi.IsDeleted,
		       'DELETE',
		       @Reason,
		       @DeleteBy,
		       GETDATE()
		FROM   Report_DataImports AS rdi
		WHERE  rdi.EnterpriseId = @EnterpriseId
		       AND DATEDIFF(MONTH, rdi.ForMonth, @OnMonth) = 0
		
		DELETE rdi
		FROM   Report_DataImports AS rdi
		WHERE  rdi.EnterpriseId = @EnterpriseId
		       AND DATEDIFF(MONTH, rdi.ForMonth, @OnMonth) = 0
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		BEGIN
		    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
		    SET @EnterpriseId = 0
		END
		
		INSERT INTO [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_ProcedureLogs
		  (
		    LogDate,
		    ProcedureName,
		    ErrorLine,
		    ErrorMessage,
		    AdditionalInfo
		  )
		SELECT GETDATE(),
		       ERROR_PROCEDURE()  AS ErrorProcedure,
		       ERROR_LINE()       AS ErrorLine,
		       ERROR_MESSAGE()    AS ErrorMessage,
		       NULL
		
		RETURN @EnterpriseId
	END CATCH
	
	IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
	BEGIN
	    COMMIT TRANSACTION
	END
	
	RETURN @EnterpriseId
END

name: p_Report_DataImports_Get_IndustryScope
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.p_Report_DataImports_Get_IndustryScope
	@ForEmp VARCHAR(500),
	@EnterpriseIds VARCHAR(500),
	@FromMonth DATETIME,
	@ToMonth DATETIME,
	@TypeBusinessIds VARCHAR(500),
	@Search NVARCHAR(250),
	@Order VARCHAR(3),
	@OrderDir VARCHAR(10),
	@PageIndex INT,
	@PageSize INT,
 @IndustryUserName varchar(255)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	SET @Order = ISNULL(@Order, '0')
	SET @OrderDir = ISNULL(@OrderDir, 'ASC')
	SET @PageIndex = ISNULL(@PageIndex, 0)
	SET @PageSize = ISNULL(@PageSize, 10)

	DECLARE @DayDeadlineSendReportLate INT;
	SELECT @DayDeadlineSendReportLate = CAST(ISNULL(sc.ConfigValue, 0) AS INT)
	FROM   [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_Configs AS sc
	WHERE  sc.ConfigKey = 'Day_Deadline_Send_Late_Report'
	       AND sc.IsDeleted = 0


    DECLARE @IsAdmin BIT = 0;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_UserRoles ur
        INNER JOIN [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_Users u ON ur.UserId = u.UserId
        WHERE (u.UserName = @ForEmp OR u.Email = @ForEmp)
          AND ur.RoleId IN (1, 6)
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @IsAdmin = 1;
    END


    DECLARE @UserFullName NVARCHAR(250) = NULL;
    DECLARE @UserEmail VARCHAR(250) = NULL;
    SELECT TOP 1 @UserFullName = FullName, @UserEmail = Email
    FROM [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_Users
    WHERE UserName = @ForEmp OR Email = @ForEmp;


    DECLARE @HasExplicitPermissions BIT = 0;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Cate_EnterprisePermissions
        WHERE ForUser = @ForEmp
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @HasExplicitPermissions = 1;
    END

	;WITH D AS (
	    SELECT rdi.EnterpriseId,
	           ce.BusinessName     AS EnterpriseName,
	           rdi.ForMonth,
	           rdi.TypeReport,
	           rdi.TypeReportName,
	           rdi.IsLate,
	           CAST(
	               CASE WHEN DAY(GETDATE()) > @DayDeadlineSendReportLate THEN 0
	                    ELSE 1
	               END AS BIT
	           )                   AS CanDelete,
	           su.FullName         AS CreatedBy,
	           DATEADD(
	               millisecond,
	               -DATEPART(millisecond, rdi.CreatedDate),
	               rdi.CreatedDate
	           )                   AS CreatedDate
	    FROM dbo.f_Report_IndustryDataImports(@IndustryUserName)  AS rdi
	           INNER JOIN [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.f_Report_IndustryEnterprises(@IndustryUserName) AS ce
	                ON  ce.EnterpriseId = rdi.EnterpriseId
	           LEFT JOIN [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Cate_EnterprisePermissions AS cep
	                ON  cep.EnterpriseId = ce.EnterpriseId
	                AND cep.ForUser = @ForEmp
	           LEFT JOIN [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_Users AS su
	                ON  rdi.CreatedBy = su.UserName
	    WHERE  rdi.IsDeleted = 0
	           AND (
	               @IsAdmin = 1
	               OR (@HasExplicitPermissions = 1 AND cep.EnterpriseId IS NOT NULL)
	               OR (@HasExplicitPermissions = 0 AND (
	                      rdi.CreatedBy = @ForEmp
	                      OR ce.TaxCode = @ForEmp
	                      OR ce.CreatedBy = @ForEmp
	                      OR cep.ForUser = @ForEmp
	                      OR (@UserEmail IS NOT NULL AND (ce.Email = @UserEmail OR ce.CreatedBy = @UserEmail))
	                      OR (@UserFullName IS NOT NULL AND ce.BusinessName = @UserFullName)
	                  ))
	           )
	           AND (
	                   @EnterpriseIds IS NULL OR @EnterpriseIds = ''
	                   OR EXISTS (
	                          SELECT 1
	                          FROM   dbo.fnSplit(@EnterpriseIds, ',') AS t
	                          WHERE  CAST(t.Name AS INT) = rdi.EnterpriseId
	                      )
	               )
	           AND (
	                   @FromMonth IS NULL
	                   OR rdi.ForMonth>=DATEADD(month,DATEDIFF(month,0,@FromMonth),0)
	               )
	           AND (
	                   @ToMonth IS NULL
	                   OR rdi.ForMonth<DATEADD(month,DATEDIFF(month,0,@ToMonth)+1,0)
	               )
	           AND (
	                   @Search IS NULL OR @Search = ''
	                   OR ce.BusinessName LIKE N'%' + @Search + '%'
	                   OR rdi.TypeReportName LIKE N'%' + @Search + '%'
	               )
	           AND (
	                   @TypeBusinessIds IS NULL OR @TypeBusinessIds = ''
	                   OR EXISTS (
	                          SELECT 1
	                          FROM   dbo.fnSplit(@TypeBusinessIds, ',') AS t
	                          WHERE  CAST(t.Name AS INT) = rdi.TypeReport
	                      )
	               )
	    GROUP BY
	           rdi.EnterpriseId,
	           ce.BusinessName,
	           rdi.ForMonth,
	           rdi.TypeReport,
	           rdi.TypeReportName,
	           rdi.IsLate,
	           su.FullName,
	           rdi.CreatedDate
	),
	T AS (
	    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
	               ORDER BY
	                    CASE WHEN @Order = '0' THEN nt.CreatedDate END ASC,
	                    CASE WHEN @Order = '1' THEN nt.EnterpriseName END ASC,
	                    CASE WHEN @Order = '2' THEN nt.ForMonth END ASC,
	                    CASE WHEN @Order = '3' THEN nt.TypeReportName END ASC,
	                    CASE WHEN @Order = '4' THEN nt.CreatedBy END ASC
	           ) AS RowIndex,
	           nt.EnterpriseId,
	           nt.EnterpriseName,
	           nt.ForMonth,
	           nt.TypeReport,
	           nt.TypeReportName,
	           nt.IsLate,
	           nt.CanDelete,
	           nt.CreatedBy,
	           nt.CreatedDate
	    FROM   D  AS nt
	    WHERE  UPPER(@OrderDir) = 'ASC'
	    UNION ALL
	    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
	               ORDER BY
	                    CASE WHEN @Order = '0' THEN nt.CreatedDate END DESC,
	                    CASE WHEN @Order = '1' THEN nt.EnterpriseName END DESC,
	                    CASE WHEN @Order = '2' THEN nt.ForMonth END DESC,
	                    CASE WHEN @Order = '3' THEN nt.TypeReportName END DESC,
	                    CASE WHEN @Order = '4' THEN nt.CreatedBy END DESC
	           ) AS RowIndex,
	           nt.EnterpriseId,
	           nt.EnterpriseName,
	           nt.ForMonth,
	           nt.TypeReport,
	           nt.TypeReportName,
	           nt.IsLate,
	           nt.CanDelete,
	           nt.CreatedBy,
	           nt.CreatedDate
	    FROM   D  AS nt
	    WHERE  UPPER(@OrderDir) = 'DESC'
	)
	SELECT T.*,
	       (
	           SELECT COUNT(RowIndex)
	           FROM   T
	       ) AS TotalRow
	FROM   T
	WHERE  (
	           @PageSize > 0
	           AND T.RowIndex BETWEEN @PageIndex + 1 AND @PageIndex + @PageSize
	       )
	       OR  @PageSize <= 0 OPTION (RECOMPILE)
END

name: p_Report_DataImports_GetForUserOnMonth_IndustryScope
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.p_Report_DataImports_GetForUserOnMonth_IndustryScope
	@ForUser VARCHAR(500),
	@OnMonth DATETIME,
 @IndustryUserName varchar(255)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;



	DECLARE @DayDeadlineSendReportLate INT;

	SELECT @DayDeadlineSendReportLate = CAST(ISNULL(sc.ConfigValue, 0) AS INT)
	FROM   [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_Configs AS sc
	WHERE  sc.ConfigKey = 'Day_Deadline_Send_Late_Report'
	       AND sc.IsDeleted = 0


    DECLARE @HasExplicitPermissions BIT = 0;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Cate_EnterprisePermissions
        WHERE ForUser = @ForUser
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @HasExplicitPermissions = 1;
    END


    DECLARE @UserFullName NVARCHAR(250) = NULL;
    DECLARE @UserEmail VARCHAR(250) = NULL;
    SELECT TOP 1 @UserFullName = FullName, @UserEmail = Email
    FROM [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_Users
    WHERE UserName = @ForUser OR Email = @ForUser;

	SELECT rdi.EnterpriseId,
	       ce.BusinessName     AS EnterpriseName,
	       rdi.ForMonth,
	       rdi.TypeReport,
	       rdi.TypeReportName,
	       rdi.IsLate,
	       CAST(
	           CASE WHEN DAY(GETDATE()) > @DayDeadlineSendReportLate THEN 0
	                ELSE 1
	           END AS BIT
	       )                   AS CanDelete,
	       su.FullName         AS CreatedBy,
	       DATEADD(
	           millisecond,
	           -DATEPART(millisecond, rdi.CreatedDate),
	           rdi.CreatedDate
	       )                   AS CreatedDate
	FROM dbo.f_Report_IndustryDataImports(@IndustryUserName)  AS rdi
	       INNER JOIN [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.f_Report_IndustryEnterprises(@IndustryUserName) AS ce
	            ON  ce.EnterpriseId = rdi.EnterpriseId
	       LEFT JOIN [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Cate_EnterprisePermissions AS cep
	            ON  cep.EnterpriseId = ce.EnterpriseId
	            AND cep.ForUser = @ForUser
	       LEFT JOIN [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_Users AS su
	            ON  rdi.CreatedBy = su.UserName
	WHERE  rdi.IsDeleted = 0
	       AND (rdi.ForMonth>=DATEADD(month,DATEDIFF(month,0,@OnMonth),0) AND rdi.ForMonth<DATEADD(month,DATEDIFF(month,0,@OnMonth)+1,0))
	       AND (
	           (@HasExplicitPermissions = 1 AND cep.EnterpriseId IS NOT NULL)
	           OR (@HasExplicitPermissions = 0 AND (
	               ce.TaxCode = @ForUser
	               OR ce.CreatedBy = @ForUser
	               OR (@UserEmail IS NOT NULL AND (ce.Email = @UserEmail OR ce.CreatedBy = @UserEmail))
	               OR (@UserFullName IS NOT NULL AND ce.BusinessName = @UserFullName)
	           ))
	       )
	GROUP BY
	       rdi.EnterpriseId,
	       ce.BusinessName,
	       rdi.ForMonth,
	       rdi.TypeReport,
	       rdi.TypeReportName,
	       rdi.IsLate,
	       su.FullName,
	       DATEADD(
	           millisecond,
	           -DATEPART(millisecond, rdi.CreatedDate),
	           rdi.CreatedDate
	       ) OPTION (RECOMPILE)
END

name: p_Report_DataImports_ImportDatas
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[p_Report_DataImports_ImportDatas] 
	@EnterpriseId INT ,
	@ForMonth DATETIME ,
	@TypeReport INT ,
	@TypeReportName NVARCHAR(1500) ,
	@DataReport dbo.DataReportWithIndexLevel READONLY,
	@ReportFile NVARCHAR(1500),
	@Reason NVARCHAR(1500) ,
	@ImportBy VARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; 
	IF NOT EXISTS(
	       SELECT 1
	       FROM   [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Cate_Enterprises AS ce
	       WHERE  ce.EnterpriseId = @EnterpriseId
	   )
	BEGIN
	    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
	    BEGIN
	        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
	    END
	    
	    RETURN -7;
	END
	
	DECLARE @DayDeadlineSendReport         INT,
	        @DayDeadlineSendReportLate     INT;
	
	SELECT @DayDeadlineSendReport = CAST(ISNULL(sc.ConfigValue, 0) AS INT)
	FROM   [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_Configs AS sc
	WHERE  sc.ConfigKey = 'Day_Deadline_Send_Report'
	       AND sc.IsDeleted = 0
	
	SELECT @DayDeadlineSendReportLate = CAST(ISNULL(sc.ConfigValue, 0) AS INT)
	FROM   [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_Configs AS sc
	WHERE  sc.ConfigKey = 'Day_Deadline_Send_Late_Report'
	       AND sc.IsDeleted = 0
	
	IF DAY(GETDATE()) > @DayDeadlineSendReportLate
	BEGIN
	    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
	    BEGIN
	        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
	    END
	    
	    RETURN -99; -- QuÃ¡ háº¡n ná»™p bÃ¡o cÃ¡o
	END
	
	DECLARE @ActionType     VARCHAR(500) = 'IMPORT',
	        @IsLate         BIT = 0;
	
	SET @IsLate = CASE 
	                   WHEN DAY(GETDATE()) >= @DayDeadlineSendReport AND DAY(GETDATE()) <= @DayDeadlineSendReportLate THEN 
	                        1
	                   ELSE 0
	              END
	
	BEGIN TRANSACTION
	BEGIN TRY
		IF EXISTS(
		       SELECT 1
		       FROM   Report_DataImports AS rdi
		       WHERE  rdi.EnterpriseId = @EnterpriseId
		              AND DATEDIFF(MONTH, @ForMonth, rdi.ForMonth) = 0
		              AND (rdi.TypeReport = @TypeReport OR @TypeReport IS NULL OR @TypeReport = 0)
		   )
		BEGIN
		    DELETE rdi
		    FROM   Report_DataImports AS rdi
		    WHERE  rdi.EnterpriseId = @EnterpriseId
		           AND DATEDIFF(MONTH, @ForMonth, rdi.ForMonth) = 0
		           AND (rdi.TypeReport = @TypeReport OR @TypeReport IS NULL OR @TypeReport = 0)
		    
		    SET @ActionType = 'UPDATE'
		END
		
		INSERT INTO Report_DataImports
		  (
		    EnterpriseId,
		    ForMonth,
		    TypeReport,
		    TypeReportName,
		    [Index],
		    [Level],
		    Targets,
		    Unit,
		    Code,
		    PerformPreviousPeriod,
		    PerformInPeriod,
		    AccumulatedBeginingOfYear,
		    ComparedSamePeriodLastYear,
		    IsDeleted,
		    IsLate,
		    CreatedBy,
		    CreatedDate
		  )
		SELECT @EnterpriseId,
		       @ForMonth,
		       @TypeReport,
		       @TypeReportName,
		       rdi.[Index],
		       rdi.[Level],
		       rdi.Targets,
		       rdi.Unit,
		       rdi.Code,
		       rdi.PerformPreviousPeriod,
		       rdi.PerformInPeriod,
		       rdi.AccumulatedBeginingOfYear,
		       rdi.ComparedSamePeriodLastYear,
		       0,
		       @IsLate,
		       @ImportBy,
		       GETDATE()
		FROM   @DataReport AS rdi
		
		INSERT INTO [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.log].dbo.Report_DataImportLogs
		  (
		    ReportId,
		    EnterpriseId,
		    ForMonth,
		    TypeReport,
		    TypeReportName,
		    Targets,
		    Unit,
		    Code,
		    PerformPreviousPeriod,
		    PerformInPeriod,
		    AccumulatedBeginingOfYear,
		    ComparedSamePeriodLastYear,
		    IsDeleted,
		    IsLate,
		    ActionType,
		    Reason,
		    CreatedBy,
		    CreatedDate
		  )
		SELECT rdi.ReportId,
		       rdi.EnterpriseId,
		       rdi.ForMonth,
		       rdi.TypeReport,
		       rdi.TypeReportName,
		       rdi.Targets,
		       rdi.Unit,
		       rdi.Code,
		       rdi.PerformPreviousPeriod,
		       rdi.PerformInPeriod,
		       rdi.AccumulatedBeginingOfYear,
		       rdi.ComparedSamePeriodLastYear,
		       rdi.IsDeleted,
		       @IsLate,
		       @ActionType,
		       @Reason,
		       @ImportBy,
		       GETDATE()
		FROM   @DataReport AS dr
		       INNER JOIN Report_DataImports AS rdi
		            ON  rdi.Code = dr.Code
		            AND rdi.EnterpriseId = @EnterpriseId
		            AND DATEDIFF(MONTH, @ForMonth, rdi.ForMonth) = 0
		            AND (rdi.TypeReport = @TypeReport OR @TypeReport IS NULL OR @TypeReport = 0)
		
		IF NOT EXISTS (
		       SELECT 1
		       FROM   Report_ReportFiles AS nt
		       WHERE  nt.EnterpriseId = @EnterpriseId
		              AND DATEDIFF(MONTH, nt.ForMonth, @ForMonth) = 0
		   )
		BEGIN
		    INSERT INTO Report_ReportFiles
		      (
		        EnterpriseId,
		        ForMonth,
		        ReportFile,
		        IsDeleted,
		        IsLate,
		        Reason,
		        CreatedBy,
		        CreatedDate
		      )
		    VALUES
		      (
		        @EnterpriseId,
		        @ForMonth,
		        @ReportFile,
		        0,
		        @IsLate,
		        @Reason,
		        @ImportBy,
		        GETDATE()
		      )
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		    UPDATE Report_ReportFiles
		    SET    ReportFile           = @ReportFile,
		           IsLate               = @IsLate,
		           Reason               = @Reason,
		           LastModifiedBy       = @ImportBy,
		           LastModifiedDate     = GETDATE()
		    WHERE  EnterpriseId         = @EnterpriseId
		           AND DATEDIFF(MONTH, ForMonth, @ForMonth) = 0
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		BEGIN
		    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
		    SET @EnterpriseId = 0
		END
		
		INSERT INTO [baocao.sct.cenit.vn.cate].dbo.Sys_ProcedureLogs
		  (
		    LogDate,
		    ProcedureName,
		    ErrorLine,
		    ErrorMessage,
		    AdditionalInfo
		  )
		SELECT GETDATE(),
		       ERROR_PROCEDURE()  AS ErrorProcedure,
		       ERROR_LINE()       AS ErrorLine,
		       ERROR_MESSAGE()    AS ErrorMessage,
		       NULL
		
		RETURN @EnterpriseId
	END CATCH
	
	IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
	BEGIN
	    COMMIT TRANSACTION
	END
	
	RETURN @EnterpriseId
END
